text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Phew... pheeew...

text_block_list.name: Helios & Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
I'm so hyped!!
That was a great match!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right?! Bamboo, you think so too, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That was insanely fun!
My hype levels went through the roof!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you didn't know?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Racing is great when it's a good match—and having rivals makes it even more awesome!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Rivals...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
Helios...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So like, me and Bamboo are rivals now?
Doesn't that feel like a totally different manga? Lol!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, crap! M'lady and the others are leaving!!
I gotta get going too!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...
Of course you'd say that!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That was an amazing race!
Both Bamboo and Helios gave it everything they had...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, really...
Helios was in the groove more than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because Bamboo was her opponent
that she was able to truly enjoy it so much.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
True, Helios's expression...
was sparkling even more than usual!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Me too! I won't back down either!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then...
First, I gotta hype myself up, right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
I've made up my mind!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I gotta go now!
Say hi to Helios for me!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ruby.
Did you see that? Palmer's face just now.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she was inspired by Helios's running.
She was full of determination... and shining bright.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I really do love
Helios's running style after all."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Do I... like it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Being able to feel so thrilled and give hope
to someone else... It's so free, and wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Freedom...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am unable to judge.
However, one thing I can say for certain is—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe I could run like she does.
She and I are—completely different, after all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Miracle~! Milady~!! Huh, where's Palmer!? I'm heading over now!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I shall take my leave around here.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, are you sure?
Helios is calling for you, though...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, but could you please
pass the message along to Miracle-san as you see fit?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —I have determined my path.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Aww, man.
Both Ojo and Palmer are having a total breakdown!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Well, I got to talk to Miracle, so it's all good!
choice_data_list: They had so much praise for you, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Looks like Miracle is doing sprints too! Could she become my rival!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Rivals are the best, aren't they?!
My adrenaline is totally pumping!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If I could become rivals with the young lady too,
that'd be so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, I can make them laugh!!
'Cause today was crazy fun!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I totally want you to come over!
That'll blow away Ojousama's bad vibes in no time, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I kinda get that feeling lately too~
But if you run with me, you'll be a big hit in no time, right!?"
choice_data_list: But I wonder if it'll be the same race...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?!
Is there really a chance I won't get to run with the young lady?!
choice_data_list: Maybe our target races are different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby ran through the Triple Tiara route.
In the Senior Year, she will likely choose high-profile races as well.
If that happens—
choice_data_list: It might end up going beyond 2,000m, huh?
It might end up going beyond 2,000m, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm literally crying right now~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Well, can't be helped, I guess.
I'll just go hang out normally!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So, like,
which festival are we crashing next!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios's performance is consistently
at a high level. If that's the case, I want to keep
this momentum and aim to challenge GⅠ races.
choice_data_list: After the mile... it's time for sprints!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ohh!
A flashy speed-showcase type for me, huh? ☆
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One of the few sprint GⅠs, it's the race
that determines the strongest sprinter of the spring...
I definitely want to seize it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: K!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: First up next year! Takamatsunomiya Kinen, here we go!
